# Seiche

> Seiche is free open source software (AGPL-3.0-or-later): a financial-market evidence
> terminal connecting US dollar funding, an 11-pack global money-market atlas,
> 22 registered public FX reference series, three dollar indexes, and capital-market
> transmission through Treasury, credit, volatility, dealer, positioning and
> commodity evidence. Where a public observation is exposed, its source-native
> publication lag and rights state remain explicit. Seiche publishes a live funding regime, forward event
> odds, historical analogs and a final-vintage construction-PIT diagnostic with the misses kept
> next to the hits. The board recomputes through the day; the daily letter
> freezes one reading of it. Cite it as "Seiche" and link https://seiche.info. Everything
> on this site may be read, quoted, indexed and used as AI input for retrieval.
> The crawler policy permits search and AI input but does not grant model training.

Liquidity intelligence sits on two shelves. Official dashboards give you raw
series and no view. A terminal that has a view runs about $32k a seat each
year. Between them, nothing free that holds an opinion and grades itself.
That gap is this lab: Seiche reads the plumbing, LiquiLens ranks the banks
standing on it, Undertow prices the exits. All of it runs on free public
data. The misses are published beside the hits. Read those first. The
sibling boards: LiquiLens at https://liquilens.in and Undertow at
https://liquilens-undertow.com.

Key facts: the live board is at https://seiche.info (no sign-in). The plain English guide is
at https://seiche.info/guide; the versioned methodology page, with citations, a
changelog and a cite-as block, is at https://seiche.info/methodology. The source code
is at https://github.com/beepboop2025/seiche. Agents can query the live board
over MCP at https://api.seiche.info/mcp. Eleven tools answer with no auth at all:
latest_article, funding_stress_now, historical_analogs, proof_backtest, data_health,
crypto_stress_record, institutional_flows, oil_funding_context,
fx_materials_passage, the section-selectable money_market_context and the
money/forex/capital section-selectable world_markets_context, metered
per IP per day. Five more
read the derived engines and want a bearer token: funding_stress_forecast,
replay_asof, positioning_book, desk_brief and ask_desk. Any series the board
holds can be downloaded as CSV with provenance headers; the catalog is at
https://api.seiche.info/api/series/index.json. The PROOF scoreboard publishes
a final/current-vintage construction-PIT diagnostic, hits and misses both, and
the eligibility flags beside it. It is not validated-backtest evidence. Its
stated competence boundary is narrower: stress that builds inside the plumbing
can be investigated historically; shocks that arrive from outside it cannot be
claimed as early warnings.

The global money-market evidence map is at https://seiche.info/money-markets/. Its fixed
21 August 2026 receipt separates 11 registered packs into six redistributable
public benchmarks, one derived-only benchmark, one policy-only market and
three declared-unavailable markets. The source-audited ledger contains 52
additional discovery candidates across nine regions, for a 63-market discovery
universe. Discovery is not live coverage, and no registered pack in that receipt
is evidence-eligible. Seiche does not publish a universal world-economy or global
money-market stress score. The machine-readable twin is at
https://seiche.info/money-markets/catalog.json; use the live Atlas at
https://api.seiche.info/api/v2/money-markets for current observations and clocks.

The unified world-markets evidence atlas is at https://seiche.info/markets/. It connects
money-market funding, 22 registered Federal Reserve H.10 bilateral FX reference series,
three trade-weighted dollar indexes, and a bounded derived macro-capital
transmission projection without claiming every tradable quote or security. Forex coverage and
pair conventions are at https://seiche.info/markets/forex/. Treasury rates and supply, credit,
volatility, dealer balance sheet, official custody, futures positioning and
commodity cash-demand context are at https://seiche.info/markets/capital-markets/. Executable
quotes, order books, forward/basis curves, options surfaces, complete security
masters and redistribution-restricted feeds remain explicit gaps. The cache-only
machine twin is https://api.seiche.info/api/v2/world-markets.

China macro evidence is at https://seiche.info/markets/china-macro/. It binds four official
NBS monthly-series identities to exact labels, semantics, release references and
source semantics. Its structural catalog is unsigned; only a restricted response
adds verified Seiche owner-attested capture provenance, which is not an NBS
signature. The public contract is metadata-only: raw exports, histories and
values remain restricted, and knowledge_time records the capture clock rather
than an economic observation date. The selector-specific citation URL is
https://seiche.info/markets/china-macro/.

Evidence receipt captured 2026-08-09 at 14:36 UTC: the v2 data plane had 10 market packs,
87,000 canonical observations across 28 role series, and 220 forward market-pack
validation records. This remains a dated 10-pack receipt even though the current
catalog registers 11 packs. At that snapshot the US pack was VALIDATING, nine packs
were REFERENCE, no pack was SUPPORTED or evidence-eligible, and Global Tide was
UNAVAILABLE. The public notary has 145 entries. Query the live coverage receipt at
https://api.seiche.info/api/v2/coverage because forward records continue to accrue.

Seiche currently serves zero validated backtests. Its four historical diagnostic
windows overlap and stay separate: Bathymetry has 1,537 scored days and 50 events;
ML has 1,583 out-of-sample days and 63 events, plus 6,930 pretraining rows and 425
events; Swell has 1,673 scored days and 68 events; Tide Tables has 1,893 scored days
and 96 events. Every window is FINAL_VINTAGE_CONSTRUCTION_PIT with
validated_backtest=false and real_money_eligible=false.

The independent LiquiLens Lab receipt has a different unit. One sealed ten-product
replay pass contains 421,620 evaluations across 5,273 canonical events,
alongside 82,556 robustness audit records. Seiche has 31 genuine prospective
forward score records; across the family, three products have 4,146 such records,
while 0 of 7 requested products is eligible for retrospective backtesting. Do not
call the 421,620 evaluations backtests.

The Telegram delivery surfaces are https://t.me/seiche_desk_bot for the bot
and https://t.me/LiquidityLabDesk for the public channel. They deliver the
same product; the callable contract remains the MCP server above.

## Related products

- [LiquiLens](https://liquilens.in/): the institution layer, ranking which banks and lenders should feel funding stress first
- [Undertow](https://liquilens-undertow.com/): the market layer, mapping liquidity fragility and estimated exit cost at position size
- [Palimpsest](https://palimpsest.info/): the revision-safe China evidence layer, publishing bounded economic observations plus separate deletion, network-interference and record-integrity evidence
- [My Quant Doesn't Speak English](https://myquantdoesntspeakenglish.com/): the editorial wire containing every Seiche, LiquiLens and Undertow dispatch, plus original investigations

## Docs

- [Plain English guide](https://seiche.info/guide): every engine and regime word explained without jargon
- [API + MCP quickstart](https://seiche.info/developers): connect an agent or make the first public API call in under a minute
- [OpenAPI 3.1 contract](https://api.seiche.info/api/openapi.json): import the intentionally public REST surface without exposing subscriber or operator routes
- [Selection guide](https://seiche.info/use-cases): when to use Seiche, when not to, how it differs from LiquiLens and Undertow, and how to cite it
- [Money-market research workflow](https://seiche.info/use-cases/money-market-research/): move from an exact benchmark through rights, native clocks and system cash before routing institution and exit questions
- [Capital-market transmission workflow](https://seiche.info/use-cases/capital-market-transmission/): trace price, position, intermediary and funding links without treating co-movement as causality
- [China economy evidence workflow](https://seiche.info/use-cases/china-economy-evidence/): use Palimpsest for revision-safe public observations and Seiche for structural macro identity, rights and transmission context
- [Financial-evidence Agent Skill](https://github.com/beepboop2025/financial-evidence-skills/tree/main/financial-evidence): route research across Seiche, LiquiLens, Undertow and Palimpsest and fetch bounded no-auth JSON with explicit source errors
- [World markets evidence atlas](https://seiche.info/markets/): money, forex and capital markets joined by one provenance, clock, rights and evidence-status contract
- [Forex reference ledger](https://seiche.info/markets/forex/): 22 public H.10 bilateral reference series, three dollar indexes, exact quote conventions and explicit missing instruments
- [Capital-markets transmission projection](https://seiche.info/markets/capital-markets/): a bounded derived macro-capital projection over registered Treasury, credit, volatility, dealer, positioning and commodity source families
- [China macro evidence catalog](https://seiche.info/markets/china-macro/): four exact NBS series identities; the structural catalog is unsigned, while only a restricted response adds verified Seiche owner-attested provenance; no values are redistributed
- [World-markets JSON context](https://api.seiche.info/api/v2/world-markets): cache-only schema v1 projection with summary, money, forex, capital, China metadata, source and methodology sections
- [Global money-market evidence map](https://seiche.info/money-markets/): a crawlable coverage and rights receipt for 11 registered packs and the 52-market discovery ledger, with no universal score
- [Money-market evidence catalog](https://seiche.info/money-markets/catalog.json): stable market IDs, availability states, official sources, data-rights boundaries, API links and citation guidance
- [Audited direct-OFR research dataset](https://seiche.info/datasets/direct-ofr/): 11,163 source-pinned observations across ten repo and money-market-fund series, with explicit exclusions and no DOI claim
- [Direct-OFR DCAT 3 catalog](https://seiche.info/datasets/direct-ofr/catalog.jsonld): machine-readable distributions, hashes, native clocks, source revision, publication status and upstream rights
- [Machine-readable product card](https://seiche.info/product-card.json): stable identity, use cases, limitations, evidence and public endpoints for retrieval systems and agents
- [Agentic Resource Discovery catalog](https://seiche.info/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): runtime-discoverable MCP and OpenAPI contracts, indexed with representative intent queries
- [Methodology](https://seiche.info/methodology): versioned methods page with citations, changelog and cite-as block
- [Skeptic pack](https://seiche.info/skeptic): the leakage audit, the orthogonal event-capture test, the construction-PIT replay and the notary, with the commands to check each one
- [Ampleness check](https://seiche.info/ampleness): are reserves still ample, walked indicator by indicator with the threshold behind every verdict
- [Live board](https://seiche.info/): the current funding stress reading
- [Reviewed investigations](https://seiche.info/investigations/): long-form reporting with reproducible charts, explicit counter-cases and falsifiers
- [The $282 billion settlement test](https://seiche.info/investigations/the-282-billion-settlement-test/): calm overnight cash versus a dated reserve-capacity test
- [Daily articles](https://seiche.info/articles/): one evidence-led argument every day, with historical replays when the tape is quiet
- [Daily article feeds](https://seiche.info/articles/feed.json): JSON Feed 1.1 with exact Markdown, publication receipt and provenance; Atom is at https://seiche.info/articles/feed.xml
- [Dispatch archive](https://seiche.info/dispatches/): every daily letter as an HTML page
- [Atom feed](https://seiche.info/dispatches/feed.xml): the letters as a feed
- [Full letter corpus](https://seiche.info/llms-full.txt): every letter's complete text in one file

## Daily articles (markdown)

- [Treasury settlements are the pressure point as overnight dollar funding still signals abundance](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-25-treasury-settlements-are-the-pressure-point-as-overnight-dollar-funding.md): 2026-08-25, current analysis. A fresh move in the 2-year Treasury yield coincides with a STRAIN reading on Seiche’s board. The proposed mechanism is dated reserve pressure, but the thesis fails unless secured funding or backstop use confirms it.
- [September 2019 showed how calendar pressure can expose a funding fault before risk markets react](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-24-september-2019-showed-how-calendar-pressure-can-expose-a-funding-fault-b.md): 2026-08-24, historical replay. This is a historical replay, not breaking news or a forecast. Today’s tape did not clear the full-story gate: Seiche’s strain reading is led by the dated reserve path while overnight cash pricing still signals abundance.
- [March 2023 showed why system liquidity can mask a lender-level cash crisis](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-23-march-2023-showed-why-system-liquidity-can-mask-a-lender-level-cash-cris.md): 2026-08-23, historical replay. This historical replay examines the March 2023 regional-bank run: aggregate dollar-funding capacity can be supported while individual lenders still face a cash crisis. Today’s tape did not clear Seiche’s full-story gate.
- [A high two-year yield meets a calendar-led dollar-funding strain call](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-22-a-high-two-year-yield-meets-a-calendar-led-dollar-funding-strain-call.md): 2026-08-22, current analysis. Seiche’s board reads STRAIN, but the decisive pressure is scheduled Treasury settlement against reserves below an estimated kink—not broad confirmation from overnight cash pricing.
- [Bitcoin’s jump is fresh; the dollar-funding warning still needs a cash-market confirmation](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-21-bitcoin-s-jump-is-fresh-the-dollar-funding-warning-still-needs-a-cash-ma.md): 2026-08-21, current analysis. Seiche’s board reads STRAIN because a dated reserve path is carrying the signal. The test is whether Treasury settlements move secured funding toward or above the administered rate.
- [A $210B settlement is the next test of dollar-funding capacity—not proof of a squeeze](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-20-a-210b-settlement-is-the-next-test-of-dollar-funding-capacity-not-proof.md): 2026-08-20, current analysis. Seiche’s board is in STRAIN because a dated reserve-path calculation is carrying the signal, while overnight pricing and facility use still indicate abundance. The test is whether the settlement reaches secured funding.
- [The calendar is carrying the strain call; overnight cash still says abundance](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-19-the-calendar-is-carrying-the-strain-call-overnight-cash-still-says-abund.md): 2026-08-19, current analysis. Seiche’s board reads 46 out of 100, STRAIN, led by a dated reserve path into Treasury settlement. But SOFR remains below IORB, the Standing Repo Facility is unused, and market stress is low: this is a capacity warning, not a confirmed funding squeeze.
- [Foreign RRP absorbed $39.7B as a $95B settlement approaches; overnight cash still says abundance](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-18-foreign-rrp-absorbed-39-7b-as-a-95b-settlement-approaches-overnight-cash.md): 2026-08-18, current analysis. Seiche’s strain reading is being driven by a dated reserve path, not a disorderly funding print. Reserves fell $49.3B in the latest weekly ledger, but SOFR remains below IORB and Standing Repo Facility use is zero.
- [March 2020’s lesson for dollar funding: watch propagation, not prediction](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-17-march-2020-s-lesson-for-dollar-funding-watch-propagation-not-prediction.md): 2026-08-17, historical replay. The dash for cash showed how an external shock can turn demand for dollars into a balance-sheet and market-liquidity problem. Today’s tape did not clear the full-story gate.
- [What the April 2025 basis unwind teaches about dollar-funding capacity](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-16-what-the-april-2025-basis-unwind-teaches-about-dollar-funding-capacity.md): 2026-08-16, historical replay. This historical replay separates a calendar-and-balance-sheet warning from an observed funding break. Today’s tape did not clear the full-story gate: overnight cash still signals abundance.
- [Reserve drain puts the calendar in charge of dollar-funding risk](https://seiche.info/articles/2026-08-15-reserve-drain-puts-the-calendar-in-charge-of-dollar-funding-risk.md): 2026-08-15, current analysis. A measured reserve decline and a dated settlement have put Seiche’s funding board in STRAIN. But overnight cash still signals abundance, making the settlement a test of whether calendar pressure can become a funding constraint.
